name: 17362 · Spring Grove, PA
findings: ZIP 17362 (Spring Grove) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 17362 (Spring Grove) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 17362 (Spring Grove) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
